headline: Looking for something to do this week on the Treasure Coast? Here are 10 events for Sept. 5-12
teaser: From a 400-foot Cuban sandwich attempt in Palm City to family events, theater, baseball, live music and a 9/11 remembrance ceremony, here are 10 Treasure Coast events to know about for Sept. 5-12.
body:
Looking for something to do on the Treasure Coast over the next week? The calendar is packed with everything from a 400-foot Cuban sandwich attempt and family events to local theater, baseball, live music and a community remembrance ceremony.

Here are 10 events across Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties from Saturday, Sept. 5 through Saturday, Sept. 12. Event details can change, so check the linked organizer or venue page before heading out.

## 1. Bite Into History: The Longest Cuban Sandwich Ever Made

**Saturday, Sept. 12, 11 a.m.-3 p.m. | Palm City**

This is the week's standout spectacle. Volunteers at L. Cpl. Justin Wilson Memorial Park, 2051 SW Mapp Road, are planning to build a 400-foot Cuban sandwich that organizers describe as an attempt at the world's longest. The family-friendly event brings together food, community participation and the kind of oversized local challenge that is likely to be fun to watch even if you are not the one stacking the sandwich.

[Event details from Discover Martin](https://discovermartin.com/event/bite-into-history-the-longest-cuban-sandwich-ever-made/)

## 2. Family Fun Day and Touch A Truck

**Saturday, Sept. 12, 9 a.m.-2 p.m. | Sebastian**

Families with younger kids can head to Sebastian City Hall, 1225 Main St., for Family Fun Day and Touch A Truck. The event gives children a chance to get an up-close look at vehicles and equipment while spending the morning at a community event in Indian River County.

[Event details from the City of Sebastian](https://www.cityofsebastian.org/calendar.aspx?EID=5876)

## 3. Sister Act, The Musical

**Opens Thursday, Sept. 10 at 8 p.m. | Stuart**

The Barn Theatre opens its production of "Sister Act, The Musical" on Thursday night at 2400 SE Ocean Blvd. in Stuart. The Tony-nominated musical is based on the familiar hit comedy and promises big vocals, memorable characters and a feel-good story. The production runs through Sept. 27, giving theatergoers several chances to catch it after opening night.

[Event details from Discover Martin](https://discovermartin.com/event/sister-act-the-musical/)

## 4. The National Toby Keith Tribute: Beer For My Horses

**Saturday, Sept. 5, 1-4 p.m. | Fort Pierce**

Summer Crush Vineyard & Winery is pairing a Toby Keith tribute show with a local art market featuring more than 25 vendors. The opening act is scheduled for 1-2 p.m., followed by the Beer For My Horses tribute from 2-4 p.m. Admission is listed at $15.50.

[Event details from Visit St. Lucie](https://visitstlucie.com/event/the-national-toby-keith-tribute-beer-for-my-horses/)

## 5. Jupiter Hammerheads at St. Lucie Mets

**Saturday, Sept. 5 at 6:10 p.m. and Sunday, Sept. 6 at 12:10 p.m. | St. Lucie County**

Baseball fans have two chances this weekend to see the St. Lucie Mets take on the Jupiter Hammerheads in Florida State League action. Rather than taking up two spots on the list, the Saturday evening and Sunday afternoon games make one easy sports option for the weekend.

[Saturday game details](https://visitstlucie.com/event/%e2%9a%be%ef%b8%8f-jupiter-hammerheads-st-lucie-mets-3/) | [Sunday game details](https://visitstlucie.com/event/%e2%9a%be%ef%b8%8f-jupiter-hammerheads-st-lucie-mets-10/)

## 6. Ohana Surf Shop Grand Reopening

**Saturday, Sept. 5, 11 a.m.-6 p.m. | Jensen Beach**

Ohana Surf Shop is celebrating its new Hutchinson Island location at 4336 NE Ocean Blvd. with a full-day grand reopening. The event includes live music, raffles and vintage clothing, giving it more of a local beach-community feel than a typical store opening.

[Event details from Discover Martin](https://discovermartin.com/event/ohana-surf-shop-grand-reopening-new-location/)

## 7. 9/11 Remembrance Ceremony

**Friday, Sept. 11, 8:30-10:30 a.m. | Port St. Lucie**

This is not an entertainment event, but it belongs on the week's community calendar. The City of Port St. Lucie is inviting the public to gather at the Memorial Fountain at the MIDFLORIDA Event Center to reflect on the Sept. 11, 2001 attacks and remember those who lost their lives.

[Event details from Visit St. Lucie](https://visitstlucie.com/event/remembrance-ceremony/)

## 8. First Responders 5K Run

**Saturday, Sept. 12, 7:30-9 a.m. | Sebastian**

The First Responders 5K Run gives runners and walkers an outdoor option in Sebastian the morning after Sept. 11. The event adds a fitness-focused choice to the week's lineup while keeping the focus on first responders and the community.

[Event details from the City of Sebastian](https://www.cityofsebastian.org/calendar.aspx?EID=5877)

## 9. Red Hot Reggae and Salute to Bob Marley with The Klassik Band

**Saturday, Sept. 12, 1-4 p.m. | Fort Pierce**

The Klassik Band brings an afternoon of reggae to Summer Crush Vineyard & Winery, including a full set saluting Bob Marley. The event is scheduled from 1-4 p.m. and admission is listed at $6.50, making it one of the lower-cost live-music options on this week's list.

[Event details from Visit St. Lucie](https://visitstlucie.com/event/red-hot-reggae-and-salute-to-bob-marley-with-the-klassik-band-2/)

## 10. Explore the Night Sky

**Friday, Sept. 11, 3-4 p.m. | Stuart**

For something completely different, skywatchers of all ages can head to the Robert Morgade Library, 5851 SE Community Drive, for a free program with Indian River State College Professor Jon Bell. The discussion will cover programs at the Hallstrom Planetarium along with the best times to see planets, meteor activity and other night-sky sights.

[Event details from Discover Martin](https://discovermartin.com/event/explore-the-night-sky/)

Looking for more options? Browse the full [Treasure Coast Today Events calendar](https://treasurecoast.today/events.html) for events across Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties.
